Jordan/Laura — internal accounting note and checklist for this request:

Summary: CedarBay requests $1,200 promotional credit (pilot top-up) for DBY-47. No open receivable expected before August; treat as promotional allowance.

Required artifacts to proceed (we need at least items 1+2 before posting):
1) Signed acceptance (DocuSign) from finance@cedarbay.ai (or equivalent PO referencing DBY-47).
2) Statement of business purpose (short sentence captured in the DocuSign) — 'Pilot extension/top-up to complete evaluation through 2027-07-15'.
3) Proforma credit memo PDF attached to the request (Jordan to upload final).

Accounting treatment options (recommended):
- Since no invoice is outstanding, post a contra-revenue journal entry at the time of approval:
  - Debit: Promotional expense / Allowance (GLA 6402)
  - Credit: Revenue contra (GLA 4008)
  - Memo: 'Promotional trial credit - CedarBay DBY-47 - posted 2027-06-30'
- If an invoice appears within 90 days and we elect to offset, instead we will apply a credit memo referencing the invoice number. That requires AP/AR coordination.

Timing: Once we have the signed acceptance and the proforma memo, accounting posts the journal the same business day (EOD) and notifies CedarBay finance.

Please confirm if marketing requires any tracking code on the memo (e.g., 'pilot_marketing_campaign_2027') — if so, include that label in the DocuSign.

Marcus — FYI, the GLA mapping above; please review if you want a different expense classification (we typically use 6402 for customer trial allowances).

Neha Kapoor
Sr. Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
